title: What a Sparkline Shows
summary: A sparkline is the tiny chart you see next to a coin in a list. It has no axes or numbers — it is there to show the shape of recent movement at a glance.
blocks: A sparkline is the tiny chart you see next to a coin in a list. It has no axes or numbers — it is there to show the shape of recent movement at a glance.
It is meant for quick scanning: is this coin drifting up, sliding down, or chopping sideways over the window shown.
For exact figures you still look at the price and percentage change; the sparkline just gives instant visual context.
